decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost service built on existing production, still mentioned on the website, and supports competitiveness in a growing market.
The 72-hour express delivery is operationally demanding but differentiates the firm on speed, and its continued presence suggests it is still valued.
The express product line has its own page in both years and several models, which marks it as an established, actively marketed offer.
The online ordering and digital services platform is strategic infrastructure for trade partners and fits the firm's direction toward deeper service support.
The fire and smoke protection door was promoted to its own page in 2024 and serves compliance-driven demand central to the firm's safety positioning.
